**Choosing phrases**

I'm considering several ideas related to E2 stars and the idiom "have the upper hand." It might connect to a visual image of a hand above or perhaps an upper house concept. I think "upper hand" fits nicely. Another interpretation could be something like "big picture" or "top hand." So, I need to decide between "upper hand," "reach out," or "home stretch." There’s a lot to think about here!
